fact: The Global Fund's Inspector General reports that for 2023 DHIS2 reporting completeness reached 100% for HIV, 94% for malaria and 93% for TB, with timeliness of 94%, 82% and 87%, and that 6 of 10 facilities visited showed discrepancies between physical registers and DHIS2 malaria data, particularly at hospitals; the rates are for the three disease programmes, not the whole SNIS.
title: GF-OIG-25-005
publisher: The Global Fund, Office of the Inspector General
